Bueno, excepto que cuando estaba haciendo la fila, como todos los Aca, apareció un joven con dos bidones y lo atendieron primero, el motivo lo desconozco pero habia dos motos haciendo fila y sin embargo lo atendieron primero. Yo puedo entender ya que mi camioneta carga 60 litros pero las dos motos cargan menos que lo que cargo el sr de los bidones.

(Translated by Google)
Well, except that while I was in line, like everyone else here, a young man appeared with two jerrycans and they served him first. I don't know why, but there were two motorcycles in line and yet they served him first. I can understand, since my truck holds 60 liters, but the two motorcycles carry less than what the man with the jerrycans carried.
